gter gsar brngan mdos ri rab steng dpal gtor rgyan ldan/bang rim rnams la brngan spar spyi 'gre ltar ram/brngan spar med kyang mchod rdzas spyi 'gre spar

tei:div.tei:p: gter gsar brngan mdos ri rab steng dpal gtor rgyan ldan/ bang rim rnams la brngan spar spyi 'gre ltar ram/ brngan spar med kyang mchod rdzas spyi 'gre spar btab pas chog /chos skyong dgongs 'dus la gtor ma dpung rong la 'khor zur gsum brgyad dang mtheb kyus bskor ba/ dregs pa'i sde dpon la dmar gtor gcig la 'khor chung ngu sum cu/ dregs chen bco brgyad la dmar gtor che ba gcig la chung ba bco brgyad/ cung bsdu na 'khor rnams mtheb kyu byas kyang chog /dpal mgon la dkar gtor bdun cu rtsa gnyis sam dkar zlum gcig la ril bu don gnyis bzhag pa/ rgyal chen bzhi la gru bzhi mtheb ril can bzhi/ sa bdag la dkar gtor pad 'dab can la zhwa gos lh+wam dang shing rtsi ri dwags gcan gzan bum pa sogs spar btab yod pa/ brtan ma bcu gnyis la bdud mo bzhi la zur gsum nag po bzhi/ gnod sbyin bzhi la gru bzhi dmar po bzhi/ sman mo bzhi la zlum gtor dkar po bzhi/ thams cad la snying re re drung du bzhag pa'am thur ma la btsugs kyang rung*/ mgyogs gtor skabs bshos zlum dmar po bcu gnyis snying bcas byas kyang rung*/ de'ang bzhi tsho gsum bya/ de mtshams yul lha spyi la brngan gtor che bas chog kyang bkyag rgyu dkar gtor phye mar bcas dgos/ gnyan chen sde bzhi la dkar gtor gnyis dmar gtor gcig gru bzhi gcig bcas/ sgang drug bzhi bdag bcu gnyis la dkar zlum drug dang dmar gtor drug /chu bzhi'i dge bsnyen la dkar zlum sbrul dkris can bzhi/ shod chen bzhi la dmar gtor gcig dkar zlum gsum/ gter srung rnams la gtor ma dkar dmar gnyis/ dgra bla la dmar gtor rtse mo bcu gsum 'dod yon bcas/ bsang rdzas phye phur/ gser skyems chas bcas bya ba ni rgyas pa yin/ 'bring po brngan gtor gong ltar la bang rim rnams la gtor ma dkar dmar bzhag /brtan ma dang dgra bla zur du bcas pa tsam gyis 'thus/
bsdus pa brngan mdos kho na la brten kyang chog go /maṅga laṃ/// /
